title: A rooted binary tree: depth counts edges down from the root, leaves have no children
caption: The tree serialised as [10, 5, 15, 3, 7, 13, 18, 1, null, 6].

frames.text: The root 10 is at depth 0. Every node has at most two children, left and right.
Depth 1: 5 and 15. Depth 2: 3, 7, 13, 18. Depth 3: 1 and 6. The height of the tree is 4 nodes.
The leaves have no children: 1, 6, 13 and 18. Each recursive call bottoms out at one of them.
